note: *Até quando, Senhor, me esquecereis para sempre?*: D27 settles *Úsquequo … in finem* as a formula. Held against a Latinist major reading *obliviscéris* as a present (*me esqueceis*): the accent and the Greek make it future.
*hei de pôr conselhos na minha alma*: both blind readers heard advice received. D33 keeps *conselho* here as advice; *planos* is an option, and the stylist's *hei de pôr* was taken.
